SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S. 2.
REPORT
Date February 9. 1933.
Subject (in full) Confidential letter dated January 21 addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Police re communist publications.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by O.G. Luard.

With reference to the attached letter No.13,
character "Tseng" ( 政 ) dated January 21, 1933, addressed
to the Shanghai Municipal Police from General Wen Hung En,
Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, on the subject of
certain communist publications, I have to state that diligent
enquiries made by the Chinese staff of this office have
failed to find any trace of these communist publications on
sale in the Settlement.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

S.I., Please note and pass
to Reg. White.
9.2.'33

CCP

MUNICIPAL
S. B. REGIS
4437
25 / 1 33

January 24, 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.13 of January 21, regarding "The Northern Red Flag"
(北方紅旗) and other communist publications and to
inform you that the matter will receive attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

(sgd) F. W. Gerrard

Commissioner of Police.

General Wen Hung-en,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

逕覆者准
貴局本月廿一日第
多密函為查禁北
等反動刊物由准此
通令所屬從嚴查
相各區嚴切布
查照可希此致
上海市公安局
警察局長
溫鴻恩

Translation of confidential letter No.13, character Tseng
(政) dated January 21, 1933, addressed to the Commissioner
of Police from the Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau.

We have received confidential order No.506
from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai quoting
confidential notification No.40, character Ching (警),
from the Ministry of Home Affairs regarding a confi-
dential letter from the Central Propaganda Committee
on the subject of a notification from the Municipality
of Peiping, through the Central Secretariat, forwarding
the following communist publications and requesting
that they be suppressed :-

"The Northern Red Flag" (北方红旗)
"The North-Western Struggles" (西北斗争)
"The Dah Dong Civilization" (大同文化)
"Red Flag Weekly" (红旗周报)
"Can the Soviet control China ?" (苏维埃能统治中国)
"The North Western Sentry" (西北前哨)
"Letter to masses in connection with the
arrest of the revolutionary leader Chen
Tou Sen." (为逮捕革命领袖陈独秀告民众书)
"Small Red Flag" (小红旗)
"Soviet Small Newspaper" (苏维埃小报)
"Hepei Anti-Imperialist News" (河北反帝新闻)

Upon receipt of the above mentioned order
from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai we have
instructed our subordinates to suppress these
publications and hereby request you to order your
men to take similar action.

(Signed) Tsu Hsueh-pen.
